description: This file defines a generic Tensor class in Java for multi-dimensional arrays with various data types, including methods for creation, data access, resource management, and metadata. It is part of the TensorFlow Java API, providing a core data structure for tensor operations.

classes.name: Tensor
classes.description: A class representing a multi-dimensional, statically typed array used within the TensorFlow Java API. Supports creation, data access, resource management, and metadata querying.

classes.name: NativeReference
classes.description: A helper class to manage the native handle of the underlying tensor resource, including integration with eager execution sessions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a Tensor from a Java object, deducing type and shape, allocating native resources, and copying data.

methods.name: fromHandle
methods.description: Creates a Tensor object from an existing native handle, assuming ownership.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the tensor to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: shape
methods.description: Returns the shape of the tensor as an array of long dimensions.

methods.name: dataType
methods.description: Returns the DataType of elements stored in the tensor.

methods.name: numDimensions
methods.description: Returns the number of dimensions of the tensor.

methods.name: numBytes
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of the tensor data.

methods.name: numElements
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements in the tensor.

methods.name: copyTo
methods.description: Copies tensor data into a provided Java array or object.

methods.name: writeTo
methods.description: Writes tensor data into specified buffers.
